facts.text: Jon offered to send Gina a video of one of his dance routines.

evidence.quote: Sure, Gina! Wanna see one of my routines? Lemme know when you got time and I'll send you a vid.

facts.text: Gina expressed pride in Jon and anticipated watching his routine.

evidence.quote: Yeah, Jon, I'll watch your routine! So proud of you!

facts.text: Jon thanked Gina for her support and promised to send the video soon.

evidence.quote: Thanks a lot! Your help really means a lot. I'll get the video to you soon!

facts.text: Gina assured Jon of her availability to help and expressed eagerness to see the video.

evidence.quote: No prob! Always here to help. Can't wait to see the vid!
